title: Speak Now

cues.en: I am not the kind of girl
cues.zh: 我向來不是那種女孩
cues.text: I am not the kind of girl

cues.en: Who should be rudely barging in on a white veil occasion
cues.zh: 會在純白頭紗的婚禮上冒失闖入
cues.text: Who should be rudely barging in on a white veil occasion

cues.en: But you are not the kind of boy
cues.zh: 但你也不該是那種男孩
cues.text: But you are not the kind of boy

cues.en: Who should be marrying the wrong girl
cues.zh: 竟然要跟錯誤的對象共度餘生
cues.text: Who should be marrying the wrong girl

cues.en: I sneak in and see your friends
cues.zh: 我悄悄溜進禮堂看見你的朋友
cues.text: I sneak in and see your friends

cues.en: And her snotty little family
cues.zh: 還有她那些不可一世的親戚
cues.text: And her snotty little family

cues.en: All dressed in pastel
cues.zh: 全都穿著淺粉粉彩洋裝
cues.text: All dressed in pastel

cues.en: And she is yelling at a bridesmaid
cues.zh: 而她正對著伴娘大呼小叫
cues.text: And she is yelling at a bridesmaid

cues.en: Somewhere back inside a room
cues.zh: 就在後方新娘房的某個角落
cues.text: Somewhere back inside a room

cues.en: Wearing a gown shaped like a pastry
cues.zh: 身上穿著像奶油泡芙般浮誇的婚紗
cues.text: Wearing a gown shaped like a pastry

cues.en: This is certainly not what you thought it would be
cues.zh: 這絕對不是你當初所期待的幸福模樣
cues.text: This is certainly not what you thought it would be

cues.en: I lose myself in a daydream
cues.zh: 我沉浸在自己的白日夢幻想裡
cues.text: I lose myself in a daydream

cues.en: Where I stand and say
cues.zh: 幻想著我挺身站起大聲說出：
cues.text: Where I stand and say

cues.en: Don't say yes, run away now!
cues.zh: 「別答應我願意，現在就快逃吧！」
cues.text: Don't say yes, run away now!

cues.en: I'll meet you when you're out of the church
cues.zh: 「等妳踏出教堂門口，我立刻在那接你」
cues.text: I'll meet you when you're out of the church

cues.en: At the back door, don't wait or say a single vow
cues.zh: 「就在後門，別再猶豫，也別許下任何誓言」
cues.text: At the back door, don't wait or say a single vow

cues.en: You need to hear me out
cues.zh: 「你一定要聽聽我的真心話」
cues.text: You need to hear me out

cues.en: And they said, 'Speak now'
cues.zh: 他們說：「有異議請現在說出」
cues.text: And they said, 'Speak now'

cues.en: Fond gestures are exchanged
cues.zh: 台上交換著深情的眼神與手勢
cues.text: Fond gestures are exchanged

cues.en: And the organ starts to play a song that sounds like a death march
cues.zh: 風琴奏響的樂曲聽起來竟宛如喪禮進行曲
cues.text: And the organ starts to play a song that sounds like a death march

cues.en: And I am hiding in the curtains
cues.zh: 而我正屏息躲在窗簾的陰影之後
cues.text: And I am hiding in the curtains

cues.en: It seems that I was uninvited by your lovely bride-to-be
cues.zh: 看來是你那位美豔的新娘刻意沒寄邀請函給我
cues.text: It seems that I was uninvited by your lovely bride-to-be

cues.en: She floats down the aisle like a pageant queen
cues.zh: 她如選美皇后般漫步款款走下紅毯
cues.text: She floats down the aisle like a pageant queen

cues.en: But I know you wish it was me
cues.zh: 但我打從心底知道，你多希望走向你的人是我
cues.text: But I know you wish it was me

cues.en: You wish it was me, don't you?
cues.zh: 你多希望走在那裡的是我，對吧？
cues.text: You wish it was me, don't you?

cues.en: Don't say yes, run away now!
cues.zh: 「別答應我願意，現在就快逃吧！」
cues.text: Don't say yes, run away now!

cues.en: I'll meet you when you're out of the church
cues.zh: 「等妳踏出教堂門口，我立刻在那接你」
cues.text: I'll meet you when you're out of the church

cues.en: At the back door, don't wait or say a single vow
cues.zh: 「就在後門，別再猶豫，也別許下任何誓言」
cues.text: At the back door, don't wait or say a single vow

cues.en: You need to hear me out
cues.zh: 「你一定要聽聽我的真心話」
cues.text: You need to hear me out

cues.en: And they said, 'Speak now'
cues.zh: 他們說：「有異議請現在說出」
cues.text: And they said, 'Speak now'

cues.en: Don't say yes, run away now!
cues.zh: 「別答應我願意，現在就快逃吧！」
cues.text: Don't say yes, run away now!

cues.en: I'll meet you when you're out of the church
cues.zh: 「等妳踏出教堂門口，我立刻在那接你」
cues.text: I'll meet you when you're out of the church

cues.en: At the back door, don't wait or say a single vow
cues.zh: 「就在後門，別再猶豫，也別許下任何誓言」
cues.text: At the back door, don't wait or say a single vow

cues.en: Your time is running out
cues.zh: 你的時間一分一秒正在倒數流逝
cues.text: Your time is running out

cues.en: And they said, 'Speak now'
cues.zh: 牧師宣布：「有異議請現在說出」
cues.text: And they said, 'Speak now'

cues.en: Ooh, ooh, ooh...
cues.zh: （沉澱蓄勢的長音伴奏）
cues.text: Ooh, ooh, ooh...

cues.en: Hear the preacher say, 'Speak now'
cues.zh: 聽見牧師高聲宣告：「現在若有異議就說出口」
cues.text: Hear the preacher say, 'Speak now'

cues.en: 'Or forever hold your peace'
cues.zh: 「否則從此永遠保持沉默」
cues.text: 'Or forever hold your peace'

cues.en: There's the silence, there's my last chance
cues.zh: 全場一片死寂，這是我最後的翻盤機會
cues.text: There's the silence, there's my last chance

cues.en: I stand up with shaking hands, all eyes on me
cues.zh: 我顫抖著雙手毅然站起身，全場目光齊刷刷射向我
cues.text: I stand up with shaking hands, all eyes on me

cues.en: Horrified looks from everyone in the room
cues.zh: 在座每個人眼中都露出驚恐難以置信的神情
cues.text: Horrified looks from everyone in the room

cues.en: But I'm only looking at you
cues.zh: 但我眼中映照的，自始至終只有你一人
cues.text: But I'm only looking at you

cues.zh: 我向來不是那種女孩
cues.text: I am not the kind of girl

cues.text: Who should be marrying the wrong girl

cues.zh: 「所以別答應我願意，現在就快逃吧！」
cues.text: So don't say yes, run away now!

cues.en: I'll meet you when you're out of the church
cues.zh: 「等妳踏出教堂門口，我立刻在那接你」
cues.text: I'll meet you when you're out of the church

cues.en: At the back door, don't wait or say a single vow
cues.zh: 「就在後門，別再猶豫，也別許下任何誓言」
cues.text: At the back door, don't wait or say a single vow

cues.en: You need to hear me out
cues.zh: 「你一定要聽聽我的真心話」
cues.text: You need to hear me out

cues.en: And they said, 'Speak now'
cues.zh: 他們說：「有異議請現在說出」
cues.text: And they said, 'Speak now'

cues.en: And you say, 'Let's run away now!'
cues.zh: 而你轉過身對我說：「我們現在就遠走高飛吧！」
cues.text: And you say, 'Let's run away now!'

cues.en: I'll meet you when I'm out of the church at the back door
cues.zh: 「等我走出教堂後門，我立刻去找你」
cues.text: I'll meet you when I'm out of the church at the back door

cues.en: Baby, I didn't say my vows
cues.zh: 「親愛的，我根本沒有許下任何誓言」
cues.text: Baby, I didn't say my vows

cues.en: So glad you were around when they said, 'Speak now'
cues.zh: 「好慶幸當他們宣布『請現在說出』時，你在我身邊」
cues.text: So glad you were around when they said, 'Speak now'
